title: Has anyone use AI to generate game scene?
author: Beginning-Sign1916
selftext: I saw a few showcases but just wondering is it a kind of one shot or modular? Anyone willing to share on how you go about creating your game level/scene with ai? I am not talking about you grabbing pre made assets and the ai just work on it but actual raw image to 3d models and then you get the whole scene or the modular parts and then ai piece it up and design it.

comments.author: lemming1607
comments.body: make a game design document with all the features you want, create milestones and plan with ai. It will do a good job at having a reasonable pace with dependent mechanics put in first for later mechanics that require them. Then do one at a time, playtest each mechanic you add and make sure it feels right before moving to the next...rinse repeat until milestones complete

comments.author: cheyumaama
comments.body: You need to give it assets or images to build the scene. Then you need to iterate every little thing before it's high quality

comments.author: meowyih
comments.body: Seriously, it is a good way to waste your token.

replies.author: ButterflyMundane7187
replies.body: I agree in many cases. Both Godot and Unreal Engine have plenty of excellent free assets available. Using an AI agent to create 3D models in Blender or other modeling tools can be a huge waste of tokens.

comments.author: Stinky_You
comments.body:
Mine created (godot) a very rough scene from our available enemies and items, it's about 200m x 200m. It's far from finished, but it did it about 100 times faster and better than what I would have achieved given my limited experience

Edit: it's been done in steps so far and needed editing along the way.

comments.author: Beginning-Sign1916
comments.body: One of my biggest issue now is I am using ChatGPT to build out my 3d assets in blender so far its really acceptable but one look and you can tell its poor on quality and I am thinking maybe just going straight with tripo instead of wasting time and tokens

comments.author: moneydollarz
comments.body: I usually ask the models that I want to visually see my 3D level inside my workplace. Meaning ask the ai to build the level through code and it usually adds all of the engines components into the editor. I also give reference images of the level I want. It usually takes a bit of steps
